Task_Name: Phase 1: RSS Feed Reader & Infrastructure Foundation

Deliverables: Registered feedometer.com on Hostinger, configured Cloudflare DNS, SSL/TLS certificates, custom apex/www domain routing, and Cloudflare Pages hosting.
Initialized GitHub repository, configured branch workflows, and implemented automated production minification engine (build.js) achieving -38% payload reduction.

Task_Name: [P1-03] Cloudflare D1 Database & KV Schema Architecture
Deliverables: Created feedometer-db D1 database, defined publishers, feeds, and notify_signups tables with unique indexes, and bound FEEDS_KV for multi-tier global caching.

Task_Name: [P1-04] Cloudflare Edge Worker API & Routing Engine
Deliverables: Engineered stateless feedometer-worker.js with sub-10ms Edge Cache API (caches.default), KV fallback, /api/view, /api/catalog, /api/og, and /api/waitlist routes.

Task_Name: [P1-05] Universal XML Parsing & Layer A Image Extraction
Deliverables: Built universal namespace-agnostic RSS 2.0 / Atom 1.0 parser with deep extraction for Media RSS (, ), iTunes enclosures, and inline .
Implemented tracking parameter stripping (utm_*, fbclid), canonical article URL generation, atomic title-hash deduplication, and automated hate speech/extremism content filter.

Task_Name: [P1-07] Server-Side Async Hero Image Enrichment & KV Caching
Deliverables: Added non-blocking ctx.waitUntil OpenGraph hero image extraction with per-article KV caching (og:<url>, 7-day TTL), eliminating all client-side scraping loops.
Seeded 25 curated news publishers and sub-topics into D1 (seed_publishers.sql) with edge-cached /api/catalog route, stripping all hardcoded catalog JSON from frontend.

Task_Name: [P1-09] Pure Presentation Frontend & Master Design System
Deliverables: Refactored feedometer-viewer.js to pure presentation (fetch -> render), declared master :root design tokens, standardized typography H1-H6, and unified .btn / .badge schemas.

Implement D1 user and session tables (users, sessions). Build password hashing (salted SHA-256), bearer token generation, session verification, POST /api/auth/register, POST /api/auth/login, POST /api/auth/logout, and GET /api/me to establish authenticated owner accounts from Day 1.

Build the core Stream Engine (/api/stream). Delivers multi-feed fusion (10 feeds -> 1 unified stream), universal JSON normalization ({id, title, summary, link, published, source, image}), cross-feed deduplication, and sub-100ms chronological sorting backed by multi-tier caching.

Implement D1-backed user subscriptions and folder hierarchy (user_sources, folders). Expose POST /api/follow, POST /api/unfollow, POST /api/folders/create, POST /api/folders/update, GET /api/my-feeds, and GET /api/my-folders with strict token authentication.

Build keyword and catalog search engine (/api/discover?q=...). Queries D1 catalog with verified badges, presents category starter pills (News, Tech, Finance, AI, EV), and returns suggested feeds for rapid user acquisition.

Task_Name: [P2-05] Universal Website Feed Builder & Newsletter Resolver
Deliverables: Build universal website-to-feed ingestion tool (/api/builder). Probes input URLs, inspects <link rel="alternate"> headers, auto-resolves creator platforms (Substack, Beehiiv, Ghost, Medium), and provides fallback Edge HTML article extraction with live preview.

Task_Name: [P2-06] Personal Reader Actions (Starred, Read Later, History)
Deliverables: Implement D1 tables for starred_articles, saved_articles, and read_history. Provide 1-click Star, Save Later, and Read/Unread tracking with endpoints POST /api/star, POST /api/save, GET /api/my-starred, GET /api/my-saved, and POST /api/read-history.

Build custom thematic collections (collections, collection_sources). Enables users to bundle related feeds into specialized topic collections and generate collection-filtered composite streams (/api/collections/:id/stream).

Deliverables: Expand auth subsystem to support 1-click Magic Email Login (via Resend/Postmark) and Google/GitHub OAuth integrations with D1 user mapping.
Build automatic background synchronization between client state and Cloudflare D1 database, ensuring instant multi-device continuity and offline resilience.
Store user layout preferences, reading theme (dark/light/sepia), refresh frequencies, and default start pages in D1 user settings.
Handle secure HTTP-only session cookies and cross-tab BroadcastChannel communication for instant multi-tab status synchronization.
Enhance feed search modal with category exploration, popularity rankings from D1, and real-time website URL RSS autodiscovery.
Allow users to save recurring search queries as dynamic "Smart Feeds" that automatically aggregate matching articles across all subscribed feeds.
Implement custom tag pills on articles with tag filtering, allowing multi-label cross-categorization outside traditional folder hierarchies.
Generate unique public share links for user-curated feed bundles or article collections with custom branded landing cards.
Provide an automated health monitoring dashboard showing feed response times, HTTP status codes, and last-successful-fetch timestamps.

Deliverables: Build a serverless edge evaluation engine in Cloudflare Worker with full Boolean AST evaluation (AND, OR, NOT, exact quotes, nested parentheses, field targeting title:, source:, author:).
Integrate real-time notification dispatching supporting Web Push API (VAPID) and instant email alerts via transactional mail API.
Trigger secure JSON POST webhook payloads to custom HTTP endpoints whenever high-priority keyword or filter rules match incoming articles.
Pre-built webhook connectors formatting article rich cards directly into Slack channels, Discord webhooks, Microsoft Teams, and Zapier triggers.
A visual newsletter creator that compiles top starred/curated articles of the week into a responsive HTML email digest.
Integrate Cloudflare Workers AI (@cf/meta/llama-3-8b-instruct) to generate concise 2-bullet executive summaries directly inside article cards with KV response caching.
Use Cloudflare Vectorize / Text Embeddings to cluster breaking news stories across multiple publishers into single aggregated topic streams.
Automated entity extraction and sentiment analysis tracking specific companies, brand mentions, and executive announcements across global feeds.
Interactive AI chatbot enabling users to ask questions, extract key takeaways, and synthesize trends across saved article collections.
Implement multi-tenant workspace partitioning in Cloudflare D1 with workspace switcher, shared feed collections, and team member management.
Granular permissions granting Admins billing/member management, Editors feed/rule curation, and Viewers read-only dashboard access.
Single Sign-On integration via Cloudflare Access / Okta / Azure AD with comprehensive compliance audit logging for team actions.
